summary: Frontend-only regression on TyreBook Expo web preview (mobile 390x844) after Old-Tyres / Remould-Tyres modules + Dashboard KPI wiring. Dashboard now loads cleanly for Owner with NO ReferenceError for oldStock / remouldStock (the previous iteration's blocker is fully resolved). All 10 KPI cards render, both new Quick Actions (qa-old-tyres, qa-remould) are present, and both KPIs (kpi-old-sales, kpi-remould-sales, kpi-old-stock, kpi-remould-stock) navigate to the correct routes. End-to-end CRUD verified: Old Tyres → add MRF Retread-Test 205/55 R16 (Buy 1000/Sell 1500/Stock 5) → Stock Out 2 → 3 → Stock In 1 → 4. Remould Tyres → add Ceat Bike-Remould 90/90-12 (stock 3) → Truck chip shows empty state. Reports tab shows new 'Old Tyres' and 'Remould Tyres' sections with Sales Value / Tyres Sold / Current Stock / Profit rows; Today/Week/Month range chips work. Dashboard KPI values refresh on tab focus (Remould Stock updated from 0 → 3 after add). No console errors observed during any flow; only pre-existing `props.pointerEvents is deprecated` warning from an internal RN library remains.

design_issues.screen: Old Tyres / Remould Tyres list row
issues: Stock-in/out arrow glyphs (`arrow-down-thin`, `arrow-up-thin`) render as empty PUA boxes on web (`靈`, `零`) — MaterialCommunityIcons web font is missing these glyphs. Consider swapping to `arrow-down-bold` / `arrow-up-bold` or `tray-arrow-down` / `tray-arrow-up` for cross-platform rendering.

`tire` glyph shows as a plain circle on web (font lacks the newer tyre glyph). Buttons still work, but Old-Tyre-Sales / Old-Tyre-Stock icons look identical to the Remould-Stock circle. Consider `car-tire-alert` or `record-circle-outline` / `truck-flatbed` as a fallback for the web font.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard now correctly computes oldStock / remouldStock from the tyres list — bug is fully resolved. Good pattern.
TyreClassModule.tsx uses useFocusEffect to reload on focus — matches the fix requested in iteration_1.
tyre-form.tsx correctly consumes `?tyreClass=old&category=car` params, pre-selects the chips, and saves via createTyre.
